name: Great Red Sand: Long Night
description:
A Card Back won by achieving excellent results in open Genius Invokation TCG tournaments.
The Great Red Sand at night is a treacherous land of untold dangers lurking in the vast, silent darkness. It is for precisely this reason, that the twilit desert is the ideal training ground for those who yearn for strength...
